subject: Execution playbook — evaluation milestones to first invoice
messages:
From: Claire Barnes <claire@acmecorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Mike Hart <mike.hart@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Planning the evaluation -> production handoff and billing

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited to run a short evaluation. Before we kick off, procurement asked me to confirm a few items so we can line up our internal approvals:

- Evaluation length and whether Redwood will cover the evaluation (trial credit) or bill for usage.
- Billing start date: can billing be deferred until production cutover or do you invoice from trial start?
- Payment terms: our standard is Net60 — would Redwood accept Net60 for the pilot and initial months?
- PO requirements: we need to know whether a PO is required before the first invoice.

Can you share a short execution playbook that maps MAP milestones to pricing/discount triggers, and what triggers the first invoice? I want to get this into our commercial packet for legal/procurement.

Appreciate it — Claire
Claire Barnes
Director, Product
Acme Corp

Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Form.pdf (application/pdf, 45 KB)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning the evaluation -> production handoff and billing

Claire — great to hear. High level response up front, then a short execution playbook attached.

Summary:
- Evaluation: Redwood provides a 30‑day evaluation credit for hosted API access (no charge during the trial up to the agreed usage cap).
- Billing start: billing begins at the earlier of (a) production cutover (you flip traffic to live), or (b) 30 days after acceptance testing completes. We do not invoice during the free evaluation window.
- Payment terms: standard is Net30. For enterprise customers we can accept Net60 when there is a signed PO and a minimum 12‑month committed capacity. Net60 without fees is conditional on the committed contract below; otherwise Net60 accepted with a 1.5% processing surcharge.
- PO: Redwood requires a PO number prior to the first invoice if Procurement requests it. We will also accept a PO up to 10 business days after the first invoice date if your finance team needs that buffer — please flag if this is a hard constraint.

Discounts & ramp (high level):
- 0—3 month evaluation: no discounts (trial).
- Committed ramp tiers (monthly committed spend): 1) $50k+/mo = 12% off list, 2) $100k+/mo = 18% off, 3) $200k+/mo = 25% off. Discounts apply once the committed capacity is in the signed SOW and are applied pro‑rata on invoices.

Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears (one invoice per calendar month). The first invoice will pro‑rate any partial month between billing start and the month end, and will reflect any ramp commitment applied in the SOW.

Attached: Acme-MAP-v3.pdf (mutual action plan with milestone dates) and SOW template.

Next steps: if Procurement can accept the conditional Net60 tied to a 12‑month commitment, we can move to draft SOW + PO and set acceptance test dates. If Net60 must be unconditional, let us know — we can discuss the processing fee or alternate guarantees.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

Attachments: Acme-MAP-v3.pdf, SOW-Acme-Redwood.docx

From: Claire Barnes <claire@acmecorp.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Mike Hart <mike.hart@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 03 Jun 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning the evaluation -> production handoff and billing

Thanks, Soojin — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from Procurement and Legal:

1) Discount tiers — can you provide a simple table with commit thresholds and effective unit prices? Procurement wants numbers they can plug into our cost model.
2) We prefer Net60 without fees for strategic vendors. Is Redwood willing to waive the Net60 fee if we sign a 12‑month minimum commitment but the PO will land slightly after the SOW signature (finance timing) — i.e., can you accept a PO within 15 business days after the first invoice without charging the Net60 fee?
3) Billing start — our fiscal quarter begins Aug 1. If acceptance testing completes in July, is it possible to set billing start to Aug 1 so invoices align with our quarter close?

I attached the procurement intake form you requested. Also, please point us to the pricing grid so we can run internal approval.

Claire

Attachment: Acme_Procurement_Form_Filled.pdf (application/pdf, 52 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Barnes <claire@acmecorp.com>, Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>, Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning the evaluation -> production handoff and billing

Claire — looping in finance and ops details. Appreciate the procurement form. Below are concrete commitments we can include in the SOW so your legal/procurement team has what they need: 

1) Trial & acceptance
- Redwood will provide a 30‑day free evaluation credit up to the agreed usage cap listed in the MAP. No invoices issued during this 30‑day window.
- Acceptance testing window (standard): 5 business days. If acceptance criteria are met, production cutover may be scheduled.

2) Billing start date
- Default: billing starts at production cutover (recommended).
- Alternative: we can set a fixed calendar date (e.g., Aug 1) if both parties confirm in writing prior to SOW signature. Use case: aligns with your fiscal quarter.

3) Payment terms / PO
- Standard: Net30.
- Net60: Redwood will waive the Net60 processing surcharge if (a) there is a signed 12‑month minimum SOW committing to the agreed monthly capacity, and (b) a PO is submitted within 15 business days from first invoice date.
- If a PO cannot be delivered within 15 business days, Net60 can still be granted but a 1.5% processing fee applies.
- Redwood’s finance accepts PO numbers delivered as an emailed PDF or a procurement portal link. Please include billing contact and remit-to details on the PO.

4) Discounts and ramp
- Attached pricing-grid.xlsx shows list prices and the three commit tiers with example savings and effective per‑token pricing. Discounts apply as soon as the SOW is fully executed and the committed spend is in force.

5) Invoicing cadence
- Monthly in arrears. Invoices will include a line item that shows the committed discount applied and any overage usage beyond the commit.

6) First invoice content
- The first invoice will include: pro‑rated days from billing start to month end, committed discount line, and a reserve field for PO number (if pending). We will not attempt collections before PO is on file; Redwood prefers PO-first but will honor 15 business days for PO submission per the Net60 waiver above.

If that works, we'll prepare the SOW with the MAP milestones, commit tiers, and the billing start clause set to either production cutover or the negotiated calendar date (please confirm).

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: pricing-grid.xlsx

From: Claire Barnes <claire@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>, Mike Hart <mike.hart@acmecorp.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Planning the evaluation -> production handoff and billing

Marissa / Soojin — this looks good and addresses Procurement's main concerns. We are prepared to:

- Sign a 12‑month SOW with the committed ramp tiers as provided in the pricing grid.
- Submit a PO (Procurement will aim to provide the PO within 10 business days of your first invoice).
- Align billing start to production cutover; if acceptance testing completes before Aug 1 we will request billing to commence Aug 1 to align with our Q3 budget. Please include the calendar billing-start fallback language in the SOW.

Next steps for Redwood:
1) Produce SOW with MAP milestones, committed spend, tiered discounts, and the Net60 waiver clause.
2) Share final SOW PDF and HubSpot deal update (deal ACM-2026-045).
3) We'll route SOW to Legal and Procurement while the team kicks off the evaluation.

Thanks — looking forward to getting started.

Claire Barnes
Director, Product — Acme Corp
